primitives.name: No Pretense of Blocked Data Act
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Integrity rule Do not pretend blocked, metadata-only, fixture-backed, license-required, or partner-required data is active.
primitives.assumptions: Blocked data does not influence active model predictions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Attempted use of blocked data triggers immediate error.

layer2.mapping: Imposes a hard constraint on GSI's active data manifold, enforcing a separation between pretensed and genuine signals, akin to a conformal prediction set exclusion.
layer2.telemetry: Blocked-data access attempts flag integrity violations.
